# Hyperbrowser

Hyperbrowser is a next-generation platform empowering AI agents and enabling effortless, scalable browser automation.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hyperbrowser/.

## Actions

- **Create Hyperbrowser Profile**: Create a new profile.
- **Create Scrape Job**: Initiate a new scrape job.
- **Create Session**: Create a new browser session with custom stealth, proxy, and privacy settings.
- **Get Profile By ID** (read-only): Retrieve profile details by ID.
- **Get Scrape Job Result** (read-only): Fetch the status and results of a specific scrape job.
- **Get Scrape Job Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current status of a specific scrape job.
- **Get Session Details** (read-only): Retrieve session details by ID.
- **Get Session Downloads URL** (read-only): Retrieve the downloads URL for a session.
- **Get Session Recording** (read-only): Retrieve the recording URL of a session.
- **List Profiles** (read-only): List profiles.
- **List Sessions** (read-only): List sessions with optional status filter.
- **Start Crawl Job**: Start a new crawl job for a specified URL.
- **Start Extract Job**: Start an extract job.
- **Delete Profile**: Delete a profile.
- **Get browser-use task status** (read-only): Retrieve the current status of a browser-use task.
- **Get Claude Computer Use Task Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status of a Claude Computer Use task.
- **Get Crawl Job Result** (read-only): Retrieve the result of a completed crawl job.
- **Get Crawl Job Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status and results of a specific crawl job.
- **Get Extract Job Result** (read-only): Fetch the status and results of a specific extract job.
- **Get Extract Job Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status of an extract job.
- **Start Browser Use Task**: Start an asynchronous browser-use task.
- **Start Claude Computer Use Task**: Start a Claude Computer Use task.
- **Stop Browser Use Task**: Stop a running browser-use task.
- **Stop Claude Computer Use Task**: Stop a running Claude computer use task.
- **Stop Session**: Stop a running session by ID.
